name: popsicle
headline: LLM-Driven Marketing Assistant: AI Content
short_description: This project is a Streamlit-based application that utilizes GooglePalm language model to assist in generating marketing content for different age groups. The application allows users to input a product, select a marketing task (e.g., writing sales copy, creating a tweet, or writing a product description), and choose a target audience age group.
author: shaadclt

sections.overview:
LLM-Driven Marketing Assistant is a Streamlit application that leverages GooglePalm language models to generate marketing content tailored to specific audience age groups. Users input a product name, select a marketing task such as writing sales copy, creating social media tweets, or drafting product descriptions, and choose a target demographic—kids, adults, or senior citizens. The tool uses example-based templates to guide content generation, ensuring messaging resonates with each age group's preferences and communication style. This skill solves the problem of creating audience-specific marketing materials quickly without manual copywriting for each segment.
Generate age-appropriate sales copy for e-commerce products
Create targeted social media content for different demographic segments
Write product descriptions optimized for specific customer age groups
Develop marketing campaigns with demographic-specific messaging
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/shaadclt/LLM-Driven-Marketing-Assistant`
sections.usage:
```
Act as a marketing assistant for [COMPANY], a [INDUSTRY] company. Generate [MARKETING_TASK] targeting [AGE_GROUP] demographic. Focus on [KEY_FEATURES] and use a tone that resonates with this age group. Keep it concise and engaging.
```
